A '''[[Clone gunner/Legends|clone tank gunner''']]''' was stationed in the [[Both system|Bothawui system]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the events of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Piloting an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE walker]], the trooper participated in the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]] under command of [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]]. During the battle, they were part of a squadron of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] deployed to [[Golm|Bothawui Prime's]] [[Golm asteroid belt|asteroid belt]] in order to outflank the incoming [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|warships]] under command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. As the battle began, the clones managed to outflank the enemy vessels and with the help of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|warships]] which attacked the enemy from the front, they managed to win the battle.<ref name="DoaD" />
